mentions.author: hbn
mentions.story: Google Broke Image Search for Creative Commons
mentions.why: Demonstrates Google confidently giving a wrong invention date for the touch lamp.
mentions.quote: it'll pop up with a giant, confident answer of 1984, despite the fact that if you do the research yourself you can find the first patent for it was filed in 1954.

mentions.author: slipframe
mentions.story: Google turned me into a serial killer
mentions.why: Shows Google's knowledge graph taking internet claims at face value.
mentions.quote: the problem with Google's knowledge graph is that it takes everything it reads on the internet at face value.
